title: Robot Intake (RSx)
description: Mobile-robot state as a fleet manager reports it over VDA 5050: order progress and loads, the per-topic headerId as the source sequence, loadId joined to the SSCC of the unit carried. Live position and status remain the resource-pose and resource-status contracts. Every instance must also validate against GS1's EPCIS 2.0.1 JSON Schema; this profile only narrows it. 0.3.0: the robot names the party that operates it and is paid for its work (operatorRef: a trade that brings its own robot, a vendor, a fleet operator), as labor-time names a worker's employer, and the VDA 5050 map its position is on (vda5050.mapId). Additions only.

operatorRef.description: The party that operates the robot and is paid for its work -- a trade that brings its own robot, a vendor, a fleet operator -- by its issuer-owned party URI, never a name. Added in 0.3.0.

loadId.description: VDA 5050 load identification (barcode or RFID); joined to the SSCC in epcList.

mapId.description: The VDA 5050 map the robot's position and nodes are on (VDA 5050 nodePosition.mapId). Added in 0.3.0.
